title: Raise validated Ruff floor
summary: Raise the validated Ruff development and SARIF workflow floor from 0.8 to 0.15.20 while retaining the pre-1.0 ceiling.
reason: Dependabot PR #36 proved Ruff 0.15.20 across the complete GitHub matrix, and the bundled repository runtime already executes Ruff 0.15.20 successfully. Aligning both installation surfaces prevents older unsupported lint behavior from satisfying the declared environment.
behavior_before: Development and SARIF environments could resolve any Ruff release from 0.8 through the current pre-1.0 series.
behavior_after: Development and SARIF environments require Ruff 0.15.20 or newer while retaining the existing <1 compatibility ceiling.
manual_validation: PASS: bundled Ruff 0.15.20 checks src and tests.
PASS: Dependabot PR #36 complete Generated Drift, browser, Release Self-Test, Package Verify, aggregate Python, and CodeQL matrix.
rollback_plan: Restore both Ruff floors to >=0.8,<1 and rerun lint, SARIF, and the complete GitHub matrix.
notes: The update changes tooling only; no lint rule, ignore, test, architecture guardrail, or release gate is weakened.
